name: Tinker Sticky Bomb passives: Maniacal and Bombs? BOMBS! (#1215, #780)
contract: #1215, #780: both are native ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) passives, so neither needs a script. Maniacal 706375 has one effect, EffectMiscValue 11 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -2001 DieSides 1 (-2000 ms), EffectSpellClassMask (0,33554688,0) = bits 57 and 40, i.e. Sticky Bomb 500232 (flags (0,33554432,0)) plus Deploy Blast Mine 801718 (flags (0,256,0)). Bombs? BOMBS! 705789 has three effects, all on mask (0,33554432,0), so they reach Sticky Bomb only: MiscValue 11 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN -2000 ms, MiscValue 19 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME -1000 ms and MiscValue 1 SPELLMOD_DURATION -1000 ms. Sticky Bomb 500232 has Category 742, RecoveryTime 0, CategoryRecoveryTime 12000, DurationIndex 28 (SpellDuration.dbc row 28 = 5000 ms) and effect 1 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE with Amplitude 4800; Deploy Blast Mine 801718 has RecoveryTime 10000 and CategoryRecoveryTime 0. Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both the recovery and the category-recovery field, and neither spell carries SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS or a SpellCharges.dbc row, so the expected results are 12000 -> 10000 ms, 10000 -> 8000 ms, tick 4800 -> 3800 ms and aura 5000 -> 4000 ms.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Sticky Bomb keeps its 12 sec cooldown without a talent
Maniacal cuts Sticky Bomb's cooldown to 10 sec
Bombs? BOMBS! cuts Sticky Bomb's cooldown to 10 sec
Deploy Blast Mine keeps its 10 sec cooldown without a talent
Maniacal cuts Deploy Blast Mine's cooldown to 8 sec
Bombs? BOMBS! does not reach Deploy Blast Mine
Sticky Bomb's detonation tick is unmodified without a talent
Bombs? BOMBS! speeds Sticky Bomb's detonation tick to 3800 ms
Maniacal changes the cooldown only, not the detonation tick
Sticky Bomb's aura lasts 5 sec without a talent
Bombs? BOMBS! shortens Sticky Bomb's aura to 4 sec
The unmodified Sticky Bomb cast leaves a 12 sec category cooldown
Maniacal's cast leaves a 10 sec category cooldown
Apply Sticky Bomb with the unmodified Tinker as its caster
Apply Sticky Bomb with Bombs? BOMBS! as its caster
The unmodified bomb detonates 4.8 sec after application
Bombs? BOMBS! detonates the bomb 3.8 sec after application
The unmodified bomb aura lasts 5 sec
Bombs? BOMBS! keeps the aura from outliving its detonation tick
